[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
William, son of [[Glasgow-1530|Robert Glasgow]] and [[Jack-2557|Elizabeth Jack]], was born on 6 May 1795 in Barony, Lanarkshire, Scotland, according to an inspected Findmypast transcript that explicitly labels this the birth date and leaves baptism year blank.<ref>[https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F0396092&tab=this Findmypast, Scotland, Parish Births & Baptisms 1564–1929, William Glasgow, SCOT/OPR/BAP/0396092], birth date 6 May 1795, Barony, father Robt Glasgow (weaver), mother Eliz Jack, OPR 622/4, item 2, p. 30; provider transcript inspected 23 October 2026, original register image not inspected.</ref> The earlier Scotland’s People citation gives 6 May 1795 as born or baptised and is retained without treating its index wording as an independent baptism date.<ref>"Church of Scotland: Old Parish Registers - Births and Baptisms," database, National Records of Scotland, [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ ScotlandsPeople] (accessed 19 April 2025), William Glasgow born or baptised on 6 May 1795, son of Robert Glasgow & Elizabeth Jack, in Barony, Lanarkshire, Scotland; citing Parish Number 622, Ref 30/34.</ref>

In 1819, a William, Alex, James and Janet appear on the Inhabitants of Stevenston and Saltcoats list<ref>https://www.threetowners.com/1819-census/</ref>

In the 1851 census, William (age 55), Hand Loom Weaver, was the lodger of Robert Henderson at 29 Brown Street, Calton, Lanarkshire.<ref>"1851 Scotland Census," database, {{Ancestry Record|1076|1865054}} (accessed 19 April 2025), William Glasgow (55) lodger, Hand Loom Weaver, in household of Robert Henderson (40) at 29 Brown Street, Calton, Lanarkshire. Born in Glasgow, Lanark; citing Parish Calton, ED 17A, Page 9, Line 13, Roll CSSCT1851_147, Year 1851, Parish Number 622, Household schedule number 34.

== Research Notes ==
=== Birth-date source comparison, 23 October 2026 ===

The Findmypast transcript states “Birth date: 06 May 1795” and “Baptism year: -”. It gives OPR 622/4, item 2, p. 30, but its register year range is 1797–1807, later than the indexed birth date. That metadata discrepancy needs checking against the original register image; no baptism date is inferred. The earlier Scotland’s People citation remains a born-or-baptised reading. This revises the broad structured “before 6 May 1795” birth bound to the transcript’s exact stated birth date without changing the recorded parents or the independently reviewed father grade.

=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1530]] is assessed at 95% (proved). The held ScotlandsPeople Barony baptism citation explicitly names William Glasgow, 6 May 1795, as Robert Glasgow’s child with Elizabeth Jack. The 1789 Jack marriage and repeated paired parents identify the adult family convincingly.

Selected father-profile identity and paternal relationship; maternal identity is separate.

Next useful test: Read the original baptism for residence, occupation and precise mother’s surname.
